name: Koukishou Alshain
source:
Subaru got up each morning and rode the same bus on the same route into town for school.
One morning his tranquil routine was shocked by the appearance of very unusual men in black.
A friend of his uncle intervened in the nick of time. Bewildered, Subaru learned that day
about the truth inside himself.

There was a sinister shadow drawing near, and time was up.

A modern day Sci Fi adventure game.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE127697.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
斯巴鲁每天早上起床，沿着同一条路线乘坐同一辆公共汽车进城上学。
一天早上，他平静的日常生活被一个非常不寻常的黑衣人的出现所震惊。
他叔叔的一位朋友及时介入。昴很困惑，那天才得知
关于他内心的真相。

一道阴森的影子逼近，时间到了。

现代科幻冒险游戏。
